sections.text:
[Effects]
Reduces magic damage taken by XL.
Target: yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 5.
Reduces magic Ability Power by 5XL.

[Activation]
When magic damage is taken.

[Activation Rate]
S+
Activation rate scales with the number of Water elemental Helm/Hat/Armor/Clothing type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of L (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).
